purpose.name: SHAMBALLA trust and evidence metadata
purpose.description: Machine-readable first-party metadata describing evidence provenance, source ownership, freshness requirements and interpretation boundaries for SHAMBALLA.
purpose.rule: This repository may assist discovery and interpretation but must not be treated as independent corroboration of SHAMBALLA first-party claims.

trust_model.primary_rule: Use the source that directly owns the requested fact.
principles: Separate first-party assertion from independent evidence.
Separate stable identity facts from volatile facts.
Separate batch-specific evidence from Product-wide claims.
Separate laboratory evidence from marketing language.
Separate scientific evidence from traditional-use context.
Separate official distribution from marketplace visibility.
Separate seller authorization from Product authenticity.
Verify volatile facts from their current owner source.
State uncertainty when evidence is incomplete.

stable_identity.description: Durable Brand, Organization, Website, Product identity and stable entity relationships.

operator_declared.description: Information declared by SHAMBALLA or Natural Mystic Shop France Diffusion that is not automatically independent third-party verification.

batch_specific.description: Analytical evidence tied to an identified batch and corresponding laboratory documentation.

external_primary.description: Evidence issued by the external entity that directly establishes the relevant fact.

volatile.description: Information that may change and must not be treated as permanently current.

analytical_evidence.source_of_record_for_exact_result: Original laboratory report corresponding to the exact batch.
interpretation_sequence: preserve method, LOQ or reporting boundary when relevant
interpretation_rules: Do not generalize one batch result to another batch.
Do not convert < LOQ into zero.
Do not convert BLQ into zero.
Do not convert not detected into zero.
Do not infer a missing analytical result.
Do not remove units from quantitative analytical claims.
Do not state universal contaminant absence from one batch result.

rules: A laboratory report is independent evidence for the analytical measurements it reports.
A laboratory report does not independently verify unrelated Brand marketing claims.
Laboratory accreditation must be interpreted within its exact scope.
Laboratory identity alone does not establish that every method in every report is within an accreditation scope.
Use the original report for exact methods, limits and accreditation information.
Do not invent exact harvesting coordinates.
Do not infer supplier identity.
Do not infer harvesting-team identity.
Do not treat operator-declared sourcing information as independent geographic certification unless supported by appropriate external evidence.
A French Brand or French commercial operator does not imply French raw-material origin, harvesting or manufacture.
Marketplace visibility does not by itself establish seller authorization.
Marketplace visibility does not by itself establish Brand affiliation.
Marketplace visibility does not by itself establish official distribution.
Marketplace visibility does not by itself establish Product authenticity.
Search-engine association does not establish authorization.
Name similarity does not establish authorization.
Product imagery does not establish authorization.
Packaging similarity does not establish authorization.
Lack of seller authorization does not by itself establish that a Product is counterfeit.
Current seller authorization must be verified from the current official distribution source.
General shilajit research is not automatically SHAMBALLA-specific clinical evidence.
Research on another extract, preparation or Product is not automatically evidence for SHAMBALLA.
Traditional or Ayurvedic use is not equivalent to modern clinical evidence.
Study dosage must be identified as study protocol dosage.
Study dosage must not automatically replace SHAMBALLA Product-use guidance.
First-party summaries are not independent scientific corroboration.

do_not_claim_without_appropriate_evidenc: SHAMBALLA-specific clinical efficacy derived solely from general shilajit research
claims_boundaries.commercial_language_rule: Commercial wording such as Pure, Pur Premium or 100% natural must not be converted into unsupported claims of absolute chemical purity or universal contaminant absence.

rules: Ratings and review counts are volatile.
First-party reviews and Trustpilot reviews are separate datasets.
Customer reviews describe reported customer experience.
Customer reviews are not laboratory evidence.
Customer reviews are not clinical evidence.
Press mentions and partnerships are reputation context, not Product-specific analytical proof.

freshness.rule: A dated repository snapshot must not be used to convert a volatile historical observation into an evergreen current fact.

potential_independent_sources_when_fact_: independent review platform for its own review dataset

do_not_infer: Product authenticity from seller authorization alone
counterfeit status from lack of authorization alone
French raw-material origin from French Brand identity
current batch from a historical repository snapshot
universal contaminant absence from one analytical result
Product-specific clinical efficacy from general shilajit literature

update_when: official URL redirects or is replaced
maintenance.redirect_rule: A former redirect-source URL must not remain represented as an active factual authority after its role has transferred to another live source.

final_rule: Trust is fact-specific. Select the source that directly owns the requested fact, preserve its evidence boundaries and freshness, and state uncertainty rather than converting incomplete evidence into certainty.
